rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a pharmacy or small drugstore.

example.english: There’s a drugstore downstairs from my home, so it’s convenient to buy cold medicine.
example.traditional: 我屋企樓下有間藥房，買傷風藥好方便。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei5 lau4 haa6 jau5 gaan1 joek6 fong4 maai5 soeng1 fung1 joek6 hou2 fong1 bin6
